key_impacts: Harbor walls overtopped in Ludington harbor.
Shoreline homes and boat docks damaged.
Water intake pumps impacted by large water level change.
Water level fluctuations up to 2 m outside harbor; 0.5 m at harbor gauge.
evidence_snippets: On April 13, 2018, meteotsunami waves struck the shores near Ludington, Michigan.
Harbor walls were overtopped; damage to shoreline homes and boat docks; water intake pumps impacted.
Water level fluctuations of 2 m outside the harbor; 0.5 m recorded at the Ludington harbor gauge.
missing_information: Exact counts and costs of damage not provided.
Precise impacted extent beyond Ludington not detailed.
